reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to a small business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice without hype, adhering strictly to the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: The argument moves cleanly from the operational problem of messy data to concrete evaluation questions and technical fit criteria.
reasons.actionability: Outlines a clear, manageable diagnostic task (auditing one workflow) and three practical questions to assess automation viability.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately represents Bareni's process, tooling (Zapier/Make), customer ownership policy, and mandatory human oversight for payments.
